description: This file contains utility functions for exporting notes and attachments in the Notesnook project, including functions to handle content export, path resolution, and attachment embedding.

classes.name: PathTree
classes.description: A class managing hierarchical path structures for notes and attachments.

methods.name: exportNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously exports multiple notes with their associated paths and attachments.

methods.name: exportNote
methods.description: Exports a single note and its attachments, returning a structured export object.

methods.name: exportContent
methods.description: Retrieves and processes note content for export, handling decryption and attachment resolution.

methods.name: resolveAttachment
methods.description: Generates HTML for attachments based on MIME type and format, including images and web clips.

methods.name: resolvePaths
methods.description: Replaces internal note path placeholders with relative paths for export.
